assetCache.title: Cache & Preview
assetCache.intro: Clear the image transform cache (cache/), the shop collection menu Redis cache, or rebuild asset preview files (preview/). Requires catalog admin permissions.
assetCache.clearTransformCacheHint: Deletes cached transformed images only. Safe to run in production; images are recreated on next request.
assetCache.clearCollectionMenuCacheHint: Deletes Redis keys for cached collection menu and facet/product listings. Safe; data is rebuilt on the next request (no Redis clears nothing).
assetCache.regeneratePreviewsHint: Regenerates files under preview/ from source. Use if preview URLs return 404 after storage cleanup. Can take several minutes.
assetCache.regenerateConfirm: Rebuild all asset preview files from source? This can take a while.
assetCache.normalizeSourcesHint: Applies EXIF rotation to existing source files, updates width/height, and rebuilds previews. Run once after the update if shop images appear rotated.
assetCache.normalizeConfirm: Fix EXIF orientation for all image assets? This can take several minutes.
